title: Estimating Graph Dynamics from Population Observations
summary: In this paper we consider a population process evolving on a dynamic random graph. The dynamic random graph is an Erdős--Rényi graph that is resampled every time unit, independently of the previous ones, with `edge existence probability' $p$. The population process consists of $M$ individuals which reside at the vertices of the dynamic graph.
